name: Vale of White Horse Local Plan 2031: Part One - Strategic Sites and Policies (as amended by Part 2 Plan, 9 Oct 2019)
organisation-name: Vale of White Horse District Council

housing-numbers.organisation-name: Vale of White Horse District Council
housing-numbers.notes: Housing requirement (as modified by Part 2 Plan) is 22,760 for plan period 2011-2031 (adding Oxford's unmet need of 2,200). Strategic allocations total 12,495 across three sub-areas. Annual requirement of 1,028 per annum mentioned on page 24. Local Plan Part 2 allocations of 1,000 are for sites to be identified in future plan.
